summary: Tonix Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to disclose a presentation of Phase 1 trial data for TNX-4800, a Lyme disease vaccine candidate, at the Global Lyme Alliance. The filing includes pharmacokinetic simulations for a planned Phase 2 study in H1 2027. No financial terms, transactions, or special-situation events are discussed. This is a routine product pipeline update under Regulation FD.
